instruction.name: lu12i.w
instruction.description: Load a 20-bit immediate shifted left by 12 into rd.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --asm 'lu12i.w $r12, 1; lu12i.w $r13, 1; lu12i.w $r14, 1; lu12i.w $r15, 1; lu12i.w $r16, 1; lu12i.w $r17, 1; lu12i.w $r18, 1; lu12i.w $r19, 1'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 1.67 cycles. lu12i.w sustains 24/5 = 4.8 instructions per cycle, not 4: measured 4.82, 4.83, 4.80, 4.80 and 4.78 IPC at 4, 8, 16, 24 and 32 lanes over 10 runs each, which is linear and reproducible (spread below 0.5%). The related lu32i.d reaches only 4.0 IPC, so the extra rate is specific to the upper-immediate form. Verified with --method slope --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 and the 0x01 uop counter (1 uop per instruction).

notes: No GPR source; latency is not defined. Throughput only: 4.8 IPC (CPI 5/24), measured to be linear from 4 to 32 lanes.
